task_description: Extend the modern fintech redesign (established on the homepage) consistently across all remaining public pages of the Coinscribed site: news listing, article detail, category landing, calculators index + shared CalculatorLayout (all 7 calculators inherit it), bank routing number index + detail + their components, the About page, and the three legal pages. Keep the Ink & Oxblood base with the single electric-blue accent, reuse existing globals.css utilities and Reveal/AnimatedCounter/Sparkline/LineIcon/ArticleCard/CategoryBadge components, stay fully responsive and reduced-motion safe, and preserve ALL SEO metadata and JSON-LD and all calculator math and data layers unchanged.

review.summary: v1 semantic review APPROVED. Two non-blocking cosmetic issues surfaced; issue 1 (bank-detail CTA transition mismatch) fixed in commit 692e21b, issue 2 (news lead-image zoom keyboard-focus parity) intentionally left as-is per reviewer guidance to avoid a duplicate focusable link.

verification.summary: npm run lint reports no ESLint warnings or errors; npm run build completes successfully with postbuild next-sitemap. No test framework exists (test_quality/tests reflect the lint+build gate, which is the project's only automated verification). No Dockerfile so docker_build skipped. Verified: all JSON-LD preserved (Article on news/[slug], HowTo on 7 calculators, FinancialService+BreadcrumbList on bank detail, CollectionPage on bank index); calculator pages show only a 2-line accent className swap each with math untouched; zero teal/amber tokens reintroduced; diff scoped to the intended 19 source files.
